mapper.insert: INSERT INTO nw_platform_skill_publish_receipts(request_id, actor_ref, request_fingerprint, status) VALUES(CAST(#{requestId} AS uuid), #{actor}, #{fingerprint}, 'PROCESSING') ON CONFLICT (request_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE nw_platform_skill_publish_receipts SET status=#{status}, response=CAST(#{response} AS jsonb), completed_at=now() WHERE request_id=CAST(#{requestId} AS uuid) AND status='PROCESSING'
mapper.select: SELECT actor_ref, request_fingerprint AS fingerprint, status, response::text AS response_json FROM nw_platform_skill_publish_receipts WHERE request_id=CAST(#{requestId} AS uuid)
